usage: Selo circular Sharebook Originals para capas, paginas institucionais e pecas de divulgacao de obras da linha Sharebook Originals.
source: Telegram image sent by Raffa on 2026-09-27, saved as canonical local asset in the cover-direction assets folder.

default_cover_context.generator_usage: Provide this asset as a reference image when the work belongs to Sharebook Originals so the image model can place the seal without obscuring title, author, face, main character, or focal action.

validation: Seal must remain recognizable as Sharebook Originals.
Seal must not cover title, author, face, main figure, or primary dramatic focal point.
Use it deliberately as campaign/brand signal, not as a neutral bookstore cover requirement.
Final cover must still read well as a thumbnail.
